verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs and managing projects. It supports scoping the connection to an organization or project and token-free auth via the CLI login, and MCP access is included even on the free plan. A probe confirmed the dedicated MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of connecting an agent through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
When scoped, tools automatically default to the constrained org/project and unnecessary discovery tools are hidden.
It uses the CLI login, so the MCP config needs no token.
